name: Tm Headline Cards
pitch: One card per category: the latest number, its change against plan with ▲▼, and a trend, read at a glance.
question: How is each category doing right now, and which way is it heading?
questions: Which product lines are ahead of plan this month?
Which regions grew, and which slipped, since last period?
Is a dip this month a blip or part of a longer trend?
useWhen: Show the latest value and trend for a few categories.
audience: Managers and BI leads who need a compact status for up to 24 categories on one sheet.
features: The latest number, big and clear
Your look from Qlik's Styling panel
Click to filter, keys to explore

featureStrips.heading: The latest number, big and clear
featureStrips.text: Each card shows the latest value for its category in the app's own number format, so the headline reads exactly like the rest of the sheet.
featureStrips.alt: Three category cards with the latest net sales in large type, the change against plan with a triangle, and a trend line.

featureStrips.heading: Change with direction and status
featureStrips.text: The change as a difference, percent or both, with ▲▼, a vs Plan label, good direction and a neutral band. Never colour alone.
featureStrips.alt: Five category cards with the change against plan in dollars and percent, a green or red triangle and vs Plan.

featureStrips.heading: Line, area or column trends
featureStrips.text: Draw a line, area or columns, mark the latest, highest and lowest points, and add the plan or average as a dashed line.
featureStrips.alt: Two wide cards with an area trend of 18 months, the highest and lowest points marked and the plan as a dashed line.

featureStrips.heading: Your look from Qlik's Styling panel
featureStrips.text: Cards are plain by default. Choose outlined or filled cards, radius, padding, an accent bar, and each part's size and colour.
featureStrips.alt: Five filled cards with rounded corners, centred text, an area trend and a green or red accent bar along the top.

featureStrips.heading: Fits any object size
featureStrips.text: Small cards drop the change label and indicator, then the trend, then the change. Long numbers abbreviate. Compact suits dense grids.
featureStrips.alt: The same cards at three sizes: with trends, smaller without trends, and names and headlines only.

featureStrips.heading: Click to filter, keys to explore
featureStrips.text: Click a card name to select its category, or a trend point to select that category and period. Arrow keys move along the trend.
featureStrips.alt: Five category cards with one point on the Appliances trend line ringed by keyboard focus.

hero.alt: Five plain cards for product categories, each with the latest net sales, the change against plan with a green or red triangle and the label vs Plan, and an 18-month trend line.
hero.caption: Net sales by category with the change against plan and the trend of the last 18 months
